profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with five years of professional experience. I currently work for OpenEye as a Software Engineer in Test, where I develop for one of the most robust and secure video surveillance platforms.

I am an avid racing fan and enjoy working on cars, and have built racepicks.net from the ground up. I’m a builder at heart! I love building LEGOs, small carpentry projects, and of course, world class software.

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test
positions.description: OpenEye is a subsidiary of Alarm.com.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Quality Engineering · Test Automation · Claude Code · Continuous Integration (CI) · Dependency Management · Java · Integration Testing · Spring Framework

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
racepicks.net is a one-stop shop for motorsports fantasy. Featuring customizable scoring tracking against the five largest motorsports series in the world, RacePicks aims to be the best fantasy gaming site for the most obsessed fans.

As the sole engineer, I am responsible for the whole stack - from AWS infrastructure to website styling.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · React.js · TypeScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Quality Engineering · PostgreSQL · Social Media Marketing · Claude Code · Spring Boot · User Experience Design (UED) · Data Analysis · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Corporate Tools provides what small businesses need so business owners can focus on what actually matters for their business.
positions.insights: Skills: User Experience Design (UED) · Business-to-Business (B2B) · RESTful WebServices · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Sidekiq · MongoDB · Agile Application Development · Git · Full-Stack Development · Ruby on Rails · AngularJS · HTML · Application Programming Interfaces (API) · PostgreSQL · ImageMagick · Microservices · Vue.js

positions.title: Application Engineer
positions.description: Process Innovations specializes in providing monitoring support for large scale equipment. From power generation to fertilizer plants, we provided monitoring for your equipment to gain valuable operational insights.
positions.insights: Skills: User Experience Design (UED) · Microsoft Office · OSIsoft PI

positions.title: Process Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Architected the first notification system in C# based on real-time calculations so engineers knew about events on site to monitor 56 million gallons of radioactive waste.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Microsoft Office · OSIsoft PI · Agile

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Stabilized waste transfer modeling software by resolving failing tests and unit conversion inconsistencies, enabling scientists to model near-term waste treatment.
Wrote comprehensive technical documentation, instructing users on how to use the application.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Jira · Microsoft Office · Agile
